# Pryntor Engineering PR

**Linear issue:**  
**Product owner / venture:**  
**Author:**  
**Independent reviewer (not author):**  
**Change type:** feature / bug / dependency / engine / asset / infra / docs

## What actually works
- [ ] Tested locally, with exact commands, inputs and results
- [ ] Core CI passed (link to actual run)
- [ ] Installation/rollback is documented and reproducible
- [ ] No unrelated ventures are changed

## Security, money and third-party rights
- [ ] R0 unapproved spend, no renewals or credentials introduced
- [ ] Upstream repository, exact version/SHA and change provenance recorded
- [ ] Code license and retained notices reviewed independently
- [ ] Art/fonts/audio/models/animation tooling rights reviewed separately
- [ ] Dependencies and supply-chain risks assessed; SBOM/lockfile where applicable
- [ ] No private/company/customer/child data introduced into public source

## For game and visual changes
- [ ] Boot, Play button, touch and keyboard controls, restart, pause and persistence tested
- [ ] Resizing/fullscreen, safe-area layout, real mobile Safari proof attached
- [ ] Frame timing, audio, accessibility and visual canon reviewed
- [ ] Screenshots/video evidence attached, no untested "polished"/"immersive" claim
- [ ] Product owner approved original character/brand asset integration
